ref.substituent_description: H2N-C(=O)-HN-CH2CH2CH2- attached by a solid wedge to an alpha carbon that bears C(=O)-HN-aryl and an amide NH (N with H below); that NH is acylated by C(=O)-CH(iPr, solid wedge)(NHBoc). On the central benzene, with the anilide HN at C1: CH2OH at C4 (para) and CH2-N(Me)-C(=O)-O-CH2-(fluoren-9-yl) at C3 (meta to HN, ortho to CH2OH).
ref.notes: Typeset. 13 double bonds = 4 C=O (urea, two amides, carbamate) + 3 x 3 Kekule bonds in the central benzene and the two fluorene benzo rings. The amide NH between the two residues is written N with H below.

wrong.substituent_description: O=C(NH2)-HN-CH2CH2CH2- chain whose last bond is a solid wedge ending directly on the amide nitrogen (N with H below). That N is bonded to the C(=O) of the CH(iPr, solid wedge)(NHBoc) residue and to a CH2 that carries C(=O)-HN-aryl. Central benzene (circle): HN at C1, CH2OH at C4, CH2-N(Me)-C(=O)-O-CH2-(fluoren-9-yl) at C3.
overlaps_or_ambiguities: The amide N (N with H below) is drawn with three carbon bonds plus the H label (wedge from the side chain, the valine C=O carbon, and a CH2), which is hypervalent as drawn
The urea amine is written NH2 to the right of the carbonyl rather than H2N
wrong.notes: Handwritten, black ink. Four C=O double bonds; all three benzene rings drawn with circles. The citrulline alpha carbon (the CH between the NH and the C(=O)NH-aryl) has no side chain; the side chain and its wedge are attached to the N instead.

correct.substituent_description: H2N-C(=O)-HN-CH2CH2CH2- attached by a solid wedge to the alpha carbon, which bears C(=O)-HN-aryl and NH (N with H below) acylated by C(=O)-CH(iPr, solid wedge)(NHBoc). Central benzene (circle): HN at C1, CH2OH at C4, CH2-N(Me)-C(=O)-O-CH2-(fluoren-9-yl) at C3.
overlaps_or_ambiguities: The r of iPr is written with a gamma-like shape but reads as iPr
correct.notes: Handwritten, black ink. Four C=O double bonds, aromatic rings drawn with circles, two solid wedges matching the reference.

errors_in_wrong.description: In the reference the CH2CH2CH2-NH-C(=O)NH2 side chain is attached (solid wedge) to the citrulline alpha carbon, which sits between the amide NH and the C(=O)NH-aryl. In the wrong drawing the side chain's wedge bond ends on the amide nitrogen (N with H below) instead, and the alpha carbon is drawn as an unsubstituted CH2 between that N and the C(=O)NH-aryl. The N is left with three carbon bonds plus an H.

Because the side chain was moved, the reference's solid wedge at the citrulline alpha-carbon stereocentre is gone. The wedge now points at the amide nitrogen, and the alpha carbon (drawn as CH2) has no stereochemistry. The iPr wedge is still correct.

review_notes: Wrong drawing: the citrulline side chain (with its wedge) is attached to the amide N instead of the alpha carbon, which becomes a plain CH2. The corrected drawing matches the reference. Its use of aromatic circles in place of Kekule bonds and the gamma-like r in iPr are only style. The wrong drawing writes the urea NH2 on the right ('NH2' rather than 'H2N'); this is just orientation and was not counted. Transcriber_2's 'wrong' transcription describes an unrelated quinoline and was ignored.
